items.claim: Mateusz Gamrot abandoned his game plan and fought with poor fight IQ in his recent bout.
items.quote: He did not fight to a smart game plan. He ended up going to a split there... his fight IQ was horrendous

items.claim: Mateusz Gamrot has shown high-level grappling even against elite grapplers.
items.quote: we've seen his grappling has looked damn good even against very high-level grapplers.

items.claim: Ludovit Klein has decent takedown defense.
items.quote: Ludovit Klein has he does have decent takedown defense.

items.claim: Nasrat Haqparast's recent loss can be attributed to short notice and flying across the world.
items.quote: Nasrat Nasrat You could argue that was a fluke one-off. He did take that on extremely short notice. He flew across the world for that fight.

items.claim: Diego Ferreira is coming off a bad knockout loss a year ago.
items.quote: Diego Ferreira, although he's coming off of a bad knockout loss, he has had a year to kind of, you know, recover the chin a bit.

items.claim: Billy Quarantillo suffered a bad knockout loss against Cub Swanson about two years ago.
items.quote: Billy Quarantillo, same thing there. He's coming off of a bad knockout loss, but it was about two-ish years ago against Cub Swanson

items.claim: Billy Quarantillo moving up a weight class will help his durability and chin.
items.quote: I think with Billy Q moving up a weight class for this fight, I think the chin could look a bit better.

items.claim: Billy Quarantillo is coming off a long layoff of close to two years, bringing ring rust concerns.
items.quote: He is coming off of a long layoff, too. Like I said, not quite 2 years, but just about couple months shy of it. Um and you know, there could be some ring rust concerns for Billy Q in this spot.

items.claim: Diego Ferreira is the more dangerous submission grappler in the matchup.
items.quote: you could make a decent argument for Diego Ferreira. You could say he's the more dangerous submission grappler.

items.claim: Billy Quarantillo is extremely vulnerable defensively on the feet.
items.quote: I think Billy Q is extremely vulnerable on the feet defensively.
